_readme: Profiles of the compared models, all local through Ollama. Replace the model names with the exact ones (in Ollama: 'ollama list'). extra_body (optional) is passed to Ollama on every call. prompt_language (optional) is the planner prompt's language: 'pt' (default, the measured one) or 'en'. The old names ollama-pequeno and ollama-medio still work.
